final: SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_left, AVG(ratio) - 2.8518133866641566 as diff_from_global_mean, AVG(ratio - sex_avg) as avg_diff_from_sex_mean FROM (SELECT ir.ratio, sa.sex_avg, sa.SEX FROM (SELECT P.SEX, CAST(CPK AS REAL) / CAST(GPT AS REAL) as ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE CPK IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL AND GPT > 0 AND P.SEX IN ('F', 'M')) ir JOIN (SELECT SEX, AVG(CAST(CPK AS REAL) / CAST(GPT AS REAL)) as sex_avg FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE CPK IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL AND GPT > 0 GROUP BY SEX) sa ON ir.SEX = sa.SEX WHERE ir.ratio > sa.sex_avg)
